title: The QWAdata class
text: QWAdata object named list two components: $cells — cell-level measurements, one row per cell. $rings — ring-level measurements quality flags, one row per annual ring per image. least one component must present; may NULL. object carry ROXAS settings hierarchical metadata — stay accompanying QWAimages QWAmetadata object, linked QWAdata via image_label key.

title: The QWAdata class
text: normal use, QWAdata built incrementally three steps: collect_raw_data() reads cells rings tables ROXAS output files referenced QWAimages object, cleans invalid values (negatives, error codes → NA), returns minimal QWAdata raw measurements . complete_QWAdata() runs full preprocessing pipeline (see Completing QWAdata object ) check_QWAdata() validates result. can also construct QWAdata object directly existing data frames, example importing another source: constructor enforces minimal column requirements (image_label, year, xpix, ypix cells; image_label, year rings), coerces column types, fills year gaps rings sequence, checks dating problems (duplicate years, future years). warns cwttan -NA image, indicates missing cell wall thickness estimates — expected conifers, acceptable angiosperms.
code: # Step 1: read raw ROXAS output into a QWAdata object QWA_data <- collect_raw_data(rxs_images)  # Step 2: add derived measures and ring quality flags QWA_data <- complete_QWAdata(QWA_data, meta = rxs_images,                               exclude_mode = "either")  # Step 3: validate check_QWAdata(QWA_data, meta = rxs_images) QWA_data <- QWAdata(cells = df_cells, rings = df_rings)

title: The QWAdata class
text: print() reports components present dimensions, number woodpieces, slides, images, year range, — flag columns added — count incomplete, missing, duplicate rings.
code: QWA_data          # same as print(QWA_data): compact overview summary(QWA_data) # identical output

title: The QWAdata class
text: One row per cell. Columns fall three groups: Identifiers: image_label (links QWAimages), year, pixel coordinates xpix / ypix. Raw measurements: cell dimensions wall thickness directly ROXAS — lumen dimensions (drad, dtan), radial distribution (rraddistr), lumen area (la), cell wall areas (cwa), cell wall thicknesses (cwtrad, cwttan, cwtall, rtsr). Derived measures (added complete_QWAdata()): tca, rwd2, dcwt, cwtall.adj, cdrad, cdtan, cdratio, sector100, ew_lw (earlywood / latewood classification based Mork index).

title: The QWAdata class
text: One row per ring per image. Columns fall three groups: Identifiers: image_label, year, woodpiece_label, slide_label, cno (cell count per ring, derived $cells). Measurements: mean ring width (mrw), ring area (ra), complete_QWAdata(), earlywood latewood widths (eww, lww). Quality flags (added complete_QWAdata()): logical columns described next section.

title: The QWAdata class
text: complete_QWAdata() runs three operations sequence returns new QWAdata object: Derived cell measures — computes derived columns listed yet present $cells. Already-present columns skipped, re-running safe. Year sequence completion — extends $rings cover every year cells data (filling gaps cno = 0 FALSE flag columns), checks ring year exceeds outmost_year meta. Ring quality flags — adds five logical columns $rings: exclude_mode options ("either" "incomplete_only"), see main rxs2tria vignette. need finer control — example add derived measures without touching flags, recompute flags manual edits — underlying functions complete_measures() complete_flags() can called independently.
code: QWA_data <- complete_QWAdata(QWA_data, meta = rxs_images,                               exclude_mode = "either")

title: The QWAdata class
text: check_QWAdata() returns TRUE invisibly issues warnings problems found: Missing CWT (warning): image cwttan entirely NA. Dating problems (warning): undated years, duplicates, gaps, future years, years beyond outmost_year (last meta supplied). Structural errors (error): components NULL, required identifier columns missing. meta argument optional recommended: without , outmost_year check skipped.
code: check_QWAdata(QWA_data, meta = rxs_images)

title: The QWAdata class
text: QWAdata written two separate CSV files — one cells, one rings. Provide either directory (files named automatically) explicit paths: Compression defaults TRUE write_QWAdata() (unlike write_QWAimages(), defaults FALSE). read_QWAdata() accepts .csv .csv.gz.
code: # Using a directory — files named {dataset_name}_cells.csv.gz and # {dataset_name}_rings.csv.gz write_QWAdata(QWA_data, dir = "output/", dataset_name = "my_dataset")  # Or with explicit paths: write_QWAdata(QWA_data,               file_cells = "output/my_dataset_cells.csv.gz",               file_rings = "output/my_dataset_rings.csv.gz")  # Read back: QWA_data <- read_QWAdata(dir = "output/", dataset_name = "my_dataset")  # Read only rings (avoids loading a large cells file): QWA_data_rings <- read_QWAdata(dir = "output/", dataset_name = "my_dataset",                                 components = "rings")

title: The QWAimages class
text: QWAimages object tibble subclass — one row per analyzed image — collects everything rest package needs know raw ROXAS data: files live, images organized hierarchically, image EXIF properties, ROXAS (AI) settings used analysis. required input collect_raw_data() $images component inside QWAmetadata object. object carries single attribute, roxas_version ("roxas" "roxas_ai"), records software produced data determines expected column set.

title: The QWAimages class
text: normal use, call QWAimages() directly. Instead, use build_QWAimages(), combines output extract_data_structure() (hierarchical labels) collect_settings_data() (per-image ROXAS settings EXIF metadata). See main rxs2tria vignette step--step walkthrough. build_QWAimages() calls QWAimages() internally, : infers validates roxas_version $software column, coerces data tibble cleans column names, aligns column set types internal JSON schema software version (adding missing required columns NA, dropping unrecognised columns, warning coercions made), runs minimal structural check aborts result invalid. already data frame right columns — example reading non-standard source — can pass directly:
code: files        <- get_roxas_files("path/to/ROXAS_data", roxas_version = "roxas") df_structure <- extract_data_structure(files, pattern = "...") df_settings  <- collect_settings_data(   files_settings = df_structure$fname_settings,   files_images   = df_structure$fname_image,   roxas_version  = "roxas" )  rxs_images <- build_QWAimages(df_structure, df_settings) rxs_images <- QWAimages(my_df, roxas_version = "roxas")

title: The QWAimages class
text: summary() reports software version, count images, slides, woodpieces, trees, sites species present, range outmost_year values. columns fall four groups: Hierarchical labels — uniquely identify image within sampling design link images metadata tables QWAmetadata: File paths — used collect_raw_data() update_QWAdata() locate ROXAS output files: Image metadata — properties extracted image EXIF data ROXAS AI metadata file: ROXAS settings — parameters ROXAS settings ROXAS AI metadata file (e.g. magnification, threshold values). exact columns differ roxas_version values. Dating — outmost_year calendar year outermost complete ring image, used validate ring years exceed . Optional columns (always present ROXAS output) NA populated. complete_QWAimages() adds optional columns , initialized NA.
code: rxs_images          # same as print(rxs_images): prints the tibble summary(rxs_images) # compact overview

title: The QWAimages class
text: roxas_version stored object attribute (authoritative source) $software column (per-row record). two must agree. , package warn: can happen manually edit $software column combine objects different software versions. attribute always wins resolution; $software column used re-derive roxas_version reading file (since attributes persisted CSV).
code: # Warning raised by check_QWAimages() and during construction if attribute # and $software column disagree: #   ! roxas_version attribute ("roxas") does not match the software column ("roxas_ai"). #   i Check your data for mixed or incorrect software values.

title: The QWAimages class
text: check_QWAimages() runs series validations returns TRUE invisibly done: Schema compliance (warning): checks required columns present values within expected ranges given roxas_version. roxas_version consistency (warning): checks attribute matches $software column. Missing optional columns (warning): reports optional columns absent. Use complete_QWAimages() add . Invalid structure (error): aborts required columns missing object otherwise structurally broken. Warnings stop execution; flag things inspect proceeding.
code: check_QWAimages(rxs_images)

title: The QWAimages class
text: Returns new QWAimages object every optional column added initialized NA. Existing values preserved. Use passing object QWAmetadata() want fill optional fields manually.
code: rxs_images_full <- complete_QWAimages(rxs_images)

title: The QWAimages class
text: write_QWAimages() saves tibble (optionally compressed) CSV. roxas_version attribute written file — re-derived $software column file read back read_QWAimages(). means $software column must intact consistent round-tripping work correctly. compress argument adds .gz extension already present. Alternatively, naming file .csv.gz extension sufficient — vroom compresses automatically.
code: write_QWAimages(rxs_images, "output/my_dataset_QWAimages.csv.gz")  rxs_images <- read_QWAimages("output/my_dataset_QWAimages.csv.gz")

title: The QWAmetadata class
text: QWAmetadata object named list bundles metadata required TRIA database submission. ten components, one per level QWA sampling hierarchy: $images required component. others optional can populated incrementally. hierarchical components ($sites, $trees, $woodpieces, $slides) linked $images via shared label columns (site_label, tree_label, woodpiece_label, slide_label).

title: The QWAmetadata class
text: normal use, QWAmetadata assembled interactive metadata Shiny app, takes QWAimages object starting point guides components. output exported JSON file can read back time: can also construct QWAmetadata object directly, passing components already data frames: named list, example reading custom source: as_QWAmetadata() matches list names known component names, drops unrecognised names warning, calls QWAmetadata() remainder. constructor validates aligns supplied component JSON schema: column names cleaned, types coerced, unrecognised columns dropped. Missing required columns added NA warning.
code: launch_metadata_app()  QWA_metadata <- read_QWAmetadata("output/my_dataset_QWAmetadata.json") QWA_metadata <- QWAmetadata(   images = rxs_images,      # required QWAimages object   sites  = df_sites,        # optional data frames   trees  = df_trees ) QWA_metadata <- as_QWAmetadata(my_list)

title: The QWAmetadata class
text: print() shows image-level coverage (images, slides, woodpieces, trees, sites, species, year range) status optional component — present row count, flagged provided. Individual components standard data frames can accessed edited directly:
code: QWA_metadata          # same as print(QWA_metadata) summary(QWA_metadata) # identical output QWA_metadata$sites QWA_metadata$authors  # Edit in place: QWA_metadata$dataset$license <- "CC BY 4.0"

title: The QWAmetadata class
text: check_QWAmetadata() validates component turn returns TRUE invisibly done: Absent components skipped informational message. Schema compliance (warning): checks required columns present values within expected ranges component. Missing optional columns (warning): reports optional columns yet present. Hierarchy consistency (error): $sites, $trees, $woodpieces, $slides, checks every ID present $images exactly one matching row, extras duplicates. Also verifies derived counts (e.g. number trees per site) match component table $images. $images validity (delegates check_QWAimages()).
code: check_QWAmetadata(QWA_metadata)

title: The QWAmetadata class
text: Returns new QWAmetadata object optional columns added existing values preserved: $images: delegates complete_QWAimages(). Hierarchical tables ($sites, $trees, $woodpieces, $slides): table absent, pre-filled IDs counts derived $images (starting point Shiny app uses), columns initialized NA. table already present, missing optional columns added. Flat tables ($dataset, $authors, $funding, $related): absent, one-row skeleton schema columns (NA) created can see expected fields. already present, missing optional columns added. $resources: modified complete_QWAmetadata(); use add_resources() populate component.
code: QWA_metadata <- complete_QWAmetadata(QWA_metadata)

text: Resources (data files included submission) managed separately via add_resources(), scans directory, infers resource type file name, appends result $resources:
code: QWA_metadata <- add_resources(QWA_metadata, path = "output/submission_files/")

text: QWAmetadata saved JSON file, preserves nested list structure component tables single file: Partial submissions can saved reloaded time. JSON format human-readable, components can also inspected edited outside R needed.

title: The QWAprofile class
text: QWAprofile object tibble subclass — one row per position bin per ring per image — holds cell measurements aggregated along radial direction annual ring. carries single attribute, profile_type, either "sector" "band" determines bins defined. QWAprofile computed QWAdata object independent QWAimages QWAmetadata objects. link broader dataset image_label column.

title: The QWAprofile class
text: Two binning schemes available, chosen based whether relative absolute position within ring matters: Sector profiles divide ring n bins equal relative width (0–100% ring width). relative, sectors comparable across rings different absolute widths appropriate anatomical analyses. Band profiles use sliding window fixed absolute width step size (µm). suited analyses absolute radial distance cambium meaningful — example, density gradients first n µm earlywood.

title: Step-by-step instructions
text: collect_raw_data() reads cell ring measurement tables ROXAS output files, combines , performs initial cleaning: negative values error codes replaced NA, dating checked gaps future years, warning issued CWT estimates appear missing (relevant conifer data). complete_QWAdata() adds derived cell ring measures (lumen area, CWT-based density, earlywood/latewood widths, etc.) computes ring quality flags: incomplete_ring: ring inner outer image border true ring boundary visible; MRW unreliable unavailable. missing_ring: cells detected; ring added manually cross-dating (typically wedging ring). duplicate_ring: year appears one image due overlapping slides woodpiece. exclude_dupl: TRUE duplicate ring(s) selected preferred source (ranked cell count, penalising incomplete missing rings). exclude_issues: convenience flag combining incomplete /missing rings, controlled exclude_mode. exclude_mode argument determines ring issues pre-selected exclusion: "either" (default) marks incomplete missing rings; "incomplete_only" marks incomplete rings (useful missing/wedging rings still contribute chronologies).
